title: Decouple to Reuse: Fine-Grained Knowledge Augmentation for Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series forecasting is critical for demand prediction and resource management in modern Web services, yet applying pretrained Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) to downstream tasks remains challenging due to domain shifts. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically retrieve coarse-grained window contexts and may introduce context-specific noise. To address this problem, we argue that temporal patterns should be reused at a decomposition level, as effective trend and seasonal dynamics may originate from different contexts. translated_title: 解耦以复用：面向时间序列基础模型的细粒度知识增强
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测对于现代Web服务中的需求预测和资源管理至关重要，然而由于领域偏移的存在，将预训练的时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）应用于下游任务仍然充满挑战。现有的检索增强方法通常检索粗粒度的窗口上下文，可能引入与上下文相关的噪声。为解决这一问题，我们认为时间模式应当在分解层级上被复用，因为有效的趋势和季节性动态可能源自不同的上下文。我们提出了一个两阶段细粒度知识增强框架，将预训练知识解耦并整合到紧凑的、任务共享的残差码本中，以增强冻结的TSFMs。具体而言，阶段I构建了用于解耦趋势和季节性信号的双分支残差码本，阶段II则动态检索并合并这些细粒度知识（摘要内容在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出一种两阶段细粒度知识增强框架，通过将预训练知识解耦为趋势和季节性双分支残差码本并动态检索融合，以应对领域偏移、增强冻结的时间序列基础模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes a two-stage fine-grained knowledge augmentation framework that decouples pre-training knowledge into dual-branch residual codebooks for trend and seasonal signals, dynamically retrieving and merging them to enhance frozen Time Series Foundation Models against domain shifts.
